title: Dormix's Blocks
description: This Mod adds wrought iron and Limestone Variants (more will be added soon)
body:
A Simple and Small Decoration Mod that adds an entire Family of Decorative Blocks, A new Tree with its Wood Variants and a new Ingot for Decorative Use :D
(Its also my first Mod!!!)

How to get these new Features?
- Mahogany: Just go find a blue bark tree in the Savanna!
- Limestone: Just Dig!
- Wrought Iron: Just Smelt Iron Ingots!

If you have any issues like bugs or you wanted to give feedback, just email me with this address! supportdormixblocks@gmail.com
